stem.text: A circuit contains two batteries, each of negligible internal resistance, and two resistors as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a 24 V battery on the left branch; 9.0 Ω and 3.0 Ω resistors in series in the middle branch; a galvanometer on a wire joining the middle branch to the right branch; a battery labelled X on the right branch.

stem.text: The galvanometer has a current reading of zero.
What is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of battery X?
